segments.sn34.1:1.4: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo hoti, na samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo.
segments.sn34.1:1.5: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo hoti, na samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo.
segments.sn34.1:1.6: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco jhāyī neva samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo hoti, na ca samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo.
segments.sn34.1:1.7: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca hoti, samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo ca.
segments.sn34.1:1.8: Tatra, bhikkhave, yvāyaṃ jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo ca ayaṃ imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhāyīnaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca mokkho [pāmokkho (syā. kaṃ.) evamuparipi] ca uttamo ca pavaro ca.
segments.sn34.1:1.9: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, gavā khīraṃ, khīramhā dadhi, dadhimhā navanītaṃ, navanītamhā sappi, sappimhā sappimaṇḍo tatra aggamakkhāyati;
segments.sn34.1:1.10: evameva kho, bhikkhave, yvāyaṃ jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo ca ayaṃ imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhāyīnaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca mokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro cā”ti.

lines: Jhānasaṃyuttassa paṭhame samādhikusaloti paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ pañcaṅgikaṃ dutiyaṃ tivaṅgikanti evaṃ aṅgavavatthānakusalo.
Na samādhismiṃ samāpattikusaloti cittaṃ hāsetvā kallaṃ katvā jhānaṃ samāpajjituṃ na sakkoti.
Tayidaṃ samādhikosallattaṃ saha jhānaṅgayogena catubbidho jhānasamādhi, tasmā taṃ taṃ vibhāgaṃ jānantassa siddhaṃ hotīti āha –

Tattha vitakkavicārapītisukhekaggatāvasena paṭhamaṃ pañcaṅgikaṃ, pītisukhekaggatāvasena dutiyaṃ tivaṅgikaṃ, sukhekaggatāvasena tatiyaṃ duvaṅgikaṃ, upekkhekaggatāvasena catutthaṃ duvaṅgikamevāti evaṃ tasmiṃ tasmiṃ jhāne taṃtaṃaṅgānaṃ vavatthāne kusalo.
Kallaṃ katvāti samādhānassa paṭipakkhadhammānaṃ dūrīkaraṇena sahakārīkāraṇañca samādhānena samāpajjane cittaṃ samatthaṃ katvā.
Tatiyādīsu nayesu akusalopi jhānatthāya paṭipannattā “jhāyītevā”ti vutto.
